basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims take too long to settle, and what claims operating model should Atlântico Seguros move to?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why property and health claims take too long to settle and how satisfaction varies.

gate.label: Findings sign-off
gate.decision: Does the steering group accept the diagnostic findings and priorities?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the claims operating model to move to, with targets, design and roadmap, for Board decision.

gate.label: Final recommendation
gate.decision: Does the steering group approve the recommendation for the Board?

workstreams.name: Claims process baseline
workstreams.answers: Where in the property and health claims flow does settlement time accumulate?
activities: Map property and health claims flow from notice to payment
Analyze operational data on settlement time by claim type
Compare property and health steps with the motor program

deliverables.name: Settlement time baseline by claim type and stage

workstreams.name: Claims team interviews
workstreams.answers: What do the people who do the work say delays property and health claims?
activities: Interview claims handlers and supervisors in both lines
Interview the COO and Head of Claims on the 2024 program
Synthesize pain points by claim stage

deliverables.name: Interview synthesis of claims pain points

workstreams.name: Satisfaction baseline
workstreams.answers: What is current customer satisfaction on property and health claims, and how does it vary with settlement time?
activities: Review customer satisfaction data by claim type
Relate satisfaction to settlement time by claim type

deliverables.name: Customer satisfaction baseline by claim type

workstreams.name: Delay root causes
workstreams.answers: Which process steps, rules and handoffs cause the delay, and which areas should be improved first?
activities: Trace delay drivers to process steps, rules and handoffs
Rank improvement areas by effect on settlement time
Test findings with the COO and Head of Claims

deliverables.name: Diagnostic readout with prioritized improvement areas

workstreams.name: Operating model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating model options could close the settlement time gap without lowering satisfaction?
activities: Define the option set from the diagnostic findings
Compare options on settlement time and satisfaction
Propose targets for settlement time and satisfaction

deliverables.name: Claims operating model options with comparison
Proposed targets for settlement time and satisfaction

workstreams.name: Target model design
workstreams.answers: How would the chosen model work in processes, roles and governance?
activities: Detail processes, roles and governance of the chosen model
Test the design against the proposed targets

deliverables.name: Detailed design of the chosen claims model

workstreams.name: Recommendation and roadmap
workstreams.answers: What should the Board decide, and in what sequence would the move to the model happen?
activities: Sequence the steps to move to the recommended model
Draft the written report and Board presentation
Review the draft with the COO and Head of Claims

deliverables.name: Roadmap to the recommended claims model

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align scope, plan and ways of working
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm scope, plan and access to people and data?
agenda: Present the engagement plan and phases
Align on scope, including the exclusion of the claims IT system
Confirm access to people and operational data

events.label: Workshop 1: first findings
events.decision: Which delay drivers should the root-cause analysis prioritize?
agenda: Present the process and settlement time baselines
Review the interview synthesis and satisfaction baseline
Discuss delay hypotheses to test in the root-cause work

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.decision: Does the steering group accept the diagnostic findings and priorities?
agenda: Present root causes of settlement delays
Decide whether findings are accepted for the design phase

events.label: Workshop 2: model options
events.purpose: Choose the model option to detail
events.decision: Which claims operating model option goes into detailed design?
agenda: Present the options and the proposed targets
Review options against settlement time and satisfaction
Decide the option to take into detailed design

events.label: Final recommendation
events.decision: Does the steering group approve the recommendation for the Board?
agenda: Present the written report and Board presentation
Review the detailed design and transition roadmap
Confirm the recommendation to take to the Board

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given, so Diagnostic (6-8 weeks) and Design (6-8 weeks) are estimates from the method library; confirm before quoting.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, new guidance on claims-handling response times. Confirm whether it is in scope.
The Board meets on March 15, 2027 and no start date is given, so confirm the estimated 12-16 weeks finish ahead of it.
No Handover phase is planned; the written report and Board presentation are delivered at the end of Design, which keeps the plan to two phases.
